picture-pairs.name: Pija ko rej jim̧or
picture-pairs.seoTitle: Jeļā ļo̧ķ ilo̧ ro̧ ļimaroñ: Picture Pairs
picture-pairs.h1: Pija ko Rej Jim̧or: juon ikkure in kobaik pija me eaenōm̧m̧an
picture-pairs.description: Jeļā ļo̧ķ ilo̧ ro̧ ļimaroñ rej mōñā̧ bwe rej jeļā, ro̧ rej ļo̧ķ jān ro̧ rej jeļā ilo̧ jerbal ko̧ ekwe, ilo̧ ro̧ kōjrōk ko̧ ilo̧ ro̧ rej mōñā̧ ilo̧ dementia. Kōmro̧ ro̧ rej ļo̧ķ ko̧ ilo̧ ilo̧ mejān. Ejjeļok aikwi ko̧ ilo̧ jān ejjeļok aikwi.
picture-pairs.short: Pukot ruo pija ko rej āinwōt juon. Pija ko remaron̄ pād wōt im alikar.
picture-pairs.intro: Jiped juon pija, im innem jiped eo me ej āinwōt e. Pija ko rej pād wōt im alikar ilo iien otemjej, kōn menin ejjeļo̧k men kwōj aikuj keememej. N̄e ruo pija rej kobadoon, ej kōm̧m̧an kōltood ipeleer im juon kakōļļe in m̧ōk.
howTo: Kāālet jete pija ko kwōj kōjerbali. Emān pija ej juon jikin aenōm̧m̧an n̄an jinoe.
Jiped jabdewōt pija. Enaaj kōm̧m̧an kōltood ipeleen.
Jiped pija eo me ej āinwōt e. Pija ko rej pād wōt ippān doon kōn juon kakōļļe in m̧ōk.
Eļan̄n̄e ruo pija ko reoktak jān doon, ejjeļo̧k men ekaakol. Bar jiped n̄e kwo pojak wōt.
Kōkōm̧anm̧an "Pija ko renooj" n̄e kom̧ jim̧or em̧ōņōņō kōn wāween eo pija ko rej kalbubuik.
tips: Ba ātān pija ko ippān doon im bwebwenato kake: "Juon kap in ti ebūrōrō. Kwōj kōjerbal ke milik ilo ti eo am̧?"
Kōtļo̧k bwe armiij eo kwōj lale en jiped, meñe ej bōk jidik iien. Jitōn̄ wōt ijello̧kun am̧ jiped kōn e.
Pād wōt kōn emān pija io̧kwe elōn̄ iien me em̧m̧an ippāmi. Kōlōn̄ļo̧k pija ko ej juon kāālet, ejjab juon kōttōbar me kwōj aikuj tōpare.
Kōm̧adm̧ōd ilo iien me em̧ōjo̧lo̧s wōt. Juon ikkure emōj an dedeļo̧k n̄an juon iien.

faq.q: Ewōr ke kuro̧o̧k in iien ak booñ?
faq.a: Jaab. Ejjeļo̧k kuro̧o̧k, booñ, wāween watwat makūtkūt, ak luuji. Komaron̄ kakkije jabdewōt iien, im am̧ bōjrak ilo io̧lapān ej juon wāween em̧m̧an n̄an kakkije.

faq.q: Etke pija ko rej pād wōt im alikar?
faq.a: Am̧ kōtļo̧k bwe pija ko ren alikar ej kōm̧m̧an bwe ikkure in en pedped wōt ioon kalimjek im kobaik ijello̧kun keememej. Elōn̄ armiij rej loe bwe men in eaenōm̧m̧anļo̧k. Komaron̄ oktak n̄an pija ko renooj kōn wōt juon jiped eļan̄n̄e kwōj kōņaan.

faq.q: Ejjeļo̧k ke wōneen, im iikuj ke jeje etū?
faq.a: Aet, ejjeļo̧k wōneen, im ejjeļo̧k account, jeje etam̧, ak download. Ej jerbal wōt ilo web browser ilo talboon, tablet, ak kom̧pūta.

faq.q: Kōm maron̄ ke kōjerbal pija in baam̧le ko am?
faq.a: Aet. Kajjieon̄ Photo pairs, me ej kōtļo̧k am̧ kāālet pija jān kein jerbal eo am̧. Pija ko rej pād wōt ilo browser eo am̧ im rejjab wōtļo̧k n̄an bar juon jikin.

find-the-same.name: Pukot eo ej āinwōt e
find-the-same.seoTitle: Jeļā ļo̧ķ ko̧ ro̧ kōjrōk: Jeļā ļo̧ķ jān picture
find-the-same.h1: Pukot Pija eo ej Āinwōt E
find-the-same.description: One picture at the top, two to four below. Tap the one that is the same. A calm, free picture game for adults, older adults and families, with no timer.
find-the-same.short: Kalimjek pija eo ilōn̄ im jiped pija eo ej āinwōt e itulal.
find-the-same.intro: Juon wōt pija ej pād ilōn̄ in screen eo. Itulalin ewōr ruo, jilu, ak emān pija ko. Jiped eo me ej āinwōt e. Ej juon kāālet ebweiddik ilo juon iien, im ewōr elōn̄ iien n̄an bwebwenato.
howTo: Kāālet ruo, jilu, ak emān pija ko n̄an kāālet jān er. Ruo ej eo emennono tata.
Kalimjek pija eo ilōn̄ ippān doon.
Jiped pija eo ej āinwōt e itulal. Enaaj kakōļļe kōn juon m̧ōk im naan in kōkajoor ko rem̧m̧an.
Eļan̄n̄e kwōj jiped juon pija eoktak, ikkure in enaaj ba wōt ātān im kōttar. Kōttar am̧ maron̄.
Jiped "Pija eo juon" n̄e kwo pojak n̄an bar juon.
tips: Bwebwenato kōn kajjojo pija m̧okta jān am̧ kāālet: kōla ko, wāweier, im ijo kwōmaron̄ lo ie.
Ruo kāālet rejjab "pidodo tōt". Kōttōbar eo ej juon iien em̧m̧an, ejjab n̄an kajjieon̄.
Eļan̄n̄e ej pen jiped, armiij eo emaron̄ jitōn̄ im kwōmaron̄ jiped kōn e.

faq.q: Ewōr ke kuro̧o̧k in iien ak booñ?
faq.a: Jaab. Ejjeļo̧k kuro̧o̧k, booñ, wāween watwat makūtkūt, ak luuji. Komaron̄ kakkije jabdewōt iien, im am̧ bōjrak ilo io̧lapān ej juon wāween em̧m̧an n̄an kakkije.

faq.q: Ta eo enaaj waļo̧k n̄e ej jiped pija eo ejaab e?
faq.a: Ejjeļo̧k men ekaakol. Ejjeļo̧k ainañin kakūrm̧ool, koroj ebūrōrō, ak rekrōk. Ikkure in enaaj ba ātān pija eo emōj jipede im kōttar jiped eo ejeped.

faq.q: Ejjeļo̧k ke wōneen, im iikuj ke jeje etū?
faq.a: Aet, ejjeļo̧k wōneen, im ejjeļo̧k account, jeje etam̧, ak download. Ej jerbal wōt ilo web browser ilo talboon, tablet, ak kom̧pūta.

shadow-match.name: Kobaik anoon
shadow-match.seoTitle: Jeļā ļo̧ķ jān shadow: Jeļā jān ro̧ rej mōñā̧ ilo̧ online, kōmro̧ ro̧ rej ļo̧ķ ko̧
shadow-match.h1: Kobaik Anoon: Juon Ikkure in Pija me Eaenōm̧m̧an
shadow-match.description: Juon shadow ilo̧ wōt, ro̧ rūo ko̧ ilo̧ rūo ko̧ ilo̧ wōt. Bwebwenato ilo̧ picture ko̧ ilo̧ ro̧ rej kōmro̧ ro̧ shadow. Jeļā jān shadow ko̧ ilo̧ jān ro̧ rej jeļā, ro̧ kōjrōk ko̧ ilo̧ ejjeļok aikwi.
shadow-match.short: Kalimjek anoon eo im jiped pija eo me ej kōm̧m̧an anoon eo.
shadow-match.intro: Kobaik anoon ej juon makūtkūt me ejeļāikik jān peba in pejtōk ko, ak ijin ewōr pija ko rekaļļap im ejjeļo̧k aikuj in print. Juon anoon eaenōm̧m̧an ej pād ilōn̄ in screen eo im ruo, jilu, ak emān pija ko rej kōttar itulal. Jiped eo me ej kōm̧m̧an anoon eo. Wāween men ko āinwōt baajkōļ, am̧bōreļaa, ak kap in ti rebidodo n̄an bwebwenato kaki.
howTo: Kāālet ruo, jilu, ak emān pija ko n̄an kāālet jān er. Ruo ej eo emennono tata.
Kalimjek anoon eo ippān doon. Ekāāt wāween e? Eaetok ke ak ebolol?
Jiped pija eo me ej kōm̧m̧an anoon eo. Ātān enaaj waļo̧k ijin itulalin anoon eo.
Eļan̄n̄e kwōj jiped juon pija eoktak, ikkure in enaaj ba wōt ātān im kōttar. Kōttar am̧ maron̄.
Jiped "Anoon eo juon" n̄e kwo pojak n̄an bar juon.
tips: Kōjerbal addiin peim̧ n̄an ļoor tōrerein anoon eo im bwebwenato kōn wāween e.
Eļan̄n̄e anoon ko rej pen rainin, oktak n̄an Pukot eo ej āinwōt e, ijo me pija ko rej kalimjek doon.
Bwebwenato kōn pija eo n̄e emōj an loe: "Ewōr kar juon am̧ am̧bōreļaa āinwōt e."

faq.q: Ewōr ke kuro̧o̧k in iien ak booñ?
faq.a: Jaab. Ejjeļo̧k kuro̧o̧k, booñ, wāween watwat makūtkūt, ak luuji. Komaron̄ kakkije jabdewōt iien, im am̧ bōjrak ilo io̧lapān ej juon wāween em̧m̧an n̄an kakkije.

faq.q: Ro̧ rej mōñā̧ ilo̧ dementia rej jeļā kōmro̧ ro̧ shadow ko̧ ilo̧ aōrōk?
faq.a: Many adults enjoy it, including some people living with dementia, often in the earlier stages. Shapes are easier to recognize than words. It is for enjoyment and conversation, not a test, and it does not treat or slow dementia. If it causes frustration, try Find the same or simply look at pictures together.

faq.q: Ta eo ej waļo̧k ñe ej jikōt pija eo ebōd?
faq.a: Ejjeļo̧k men enana. Ejjeļo̧k ainikien kakūm̧kūm̧, debaak ekilmir ak an m̧akūtkūt. Pija eo kwōar jikōte enaaj ba etan im kōttar bwe kwōn bar jikōte bar juon.

faq.q: Ejjeļo̧k ke wōņāān, im ij aikuj ke jaini?
faq.a: Aet, ejjeļo̧k wōņāān, im ejjeļo̧k akaun, jaini, ak kōdāik m̧weiuk. Ej jerbal wōt ilo browser ilo talboon, tablet, ak kom̧pootōr.

four-together.name: Rūo ko̧ ilo̧ wōt
four-together.seoTitle: Jeļā ļo̧ķ jān picture jān ro̧ rej kōmro̧ ro̧ ļo̧ķ ko̧ ilo̧ aikwi: Rūo ko̧ ilo̧ wōt
four-together.h1: Rūo ko̧ ilo̧ wōt: Jeļā ļo̧ķ jān picture ko̧ ilo̧ ejjeļok aikwi
four-together.description: Some of the pictures share a theme, such as fruit or weather. Tap the ones that go together. A free, calm grouping game with no timer and no score.
four-together.short: Jeļā picture ro̧ rej kōmro̧ ro̧ ļo̧ķ, kōmro̧ jān ro̧ rej mōñā̧ ilo̧ ro̧ kōmro̧ ro̧ ļo̧ķ ko̧ ilo̧ jān ejjeļok aikwi ko̧.
four-together.intro: A small set of pictures, and some of them belong together: four kinds of fruit, perhaps, or four ways to travel. Tap the ones that share a theme. If a picture goes with something else, the game simply names it and waits. After a quiet pause a hint names the theme, and "Show the group" reveals the answer at any time.
howTo: Choose four, six or eight pictures. Four is the simplest, with three that go together.
Look at the pictures together and talk about what they have in common.
Aō jeļā picture juon-juon ko̧ ilo̧ ro̧ rej kōmro̧ ro̧ ļo̧ķ. Ilo̧ ro̧ ļo̧ķ ko̧ rej kōmro̧ ro̧ aō border ko̧ ilo̧ gold ilo̧ check mark.
Ilo̧ picture ro̧ rej kōmro̧ ro̧ ļo̧ķ ko̧ ilo̧ aikwi ko̧, game ko̧ rej kōmro̧ ro̧ ļo̧ķ ko̧ ilo̧ ro̧ ļo̧ķ ko̧ ilo̧ jān. Kōmro̧ ro̧ mōñā̧ ko̧ ilo̧ ro̧ ļo̧ķ jān.
Aō "Show the group" ilo̧ ro̧ rej mōñā̧, ilo̧ "Another set" ilo̧ picture ro̧ ļo̧ķ ko̧ ilo̧ ro̧ ļo̧ķ jān.
tips: Kōmro̧ ro̧ ļo̧ķ ko̧ ilo̧ aikwi ilo̧ jeļā: "Ro̧ juon ilo̧ rūo ko̧ rej kōmro̧ ro̧ ļo̧ķ jān ro̧ rej mōñā̧."
Ejjeļok aikwi ko̧ ilo̧ jān. Hint ko̧ rej kōmro̧ ro̧ ļo̧ķ juon ko̧ rej kōmro̧ ro̧ ļo̧ķ ilo̧ ro̧ kōjrōk, kōmro̧ ro̧ rej mōñā̧ ko̧ ilo̧ jān.
Kōmro̧ ro̧ ļo̧ķ ko̧ ilo̧ group ko̧ rej kōmro̧ ro̧ ļo̧ķ: jān ro̧ rej mōñā̧ ko̧ ilo̧ fruit ko̧ ro̧ rej mōñā̧, juon ilo̧ train, ilo̧ weather ko̧ ilo̧ jān.

faq.q: Ro̧ timer ilo̧ score?
faq.a: Jaab. Ro̧ clock, score, move counter ilo̧ losing jaab. Kōmro̧ ro̧ rej mōñā̧ ilo̧ ejjeļok aikwi, ilo̧ mōñā̧ ilo̧ kōjrōk ko̧ ilo̧ jān ejjeļok ko̧.

faq.q: Ej ko̧ ilo̧ aō picture ko̧ ilo̧ group jān ro̧ rej kōmro̧ ro̧ ļo̧ķ?
faq.a: Ej jaab ko̧ ilo̧ aikwi. Jaab buzzer, red cross ilo̧ shaking. Game ko̧ rej kōmro̧ ro̧ ļo̧ķ picture ko̧, rej kōmro̧ ro̧ ļo̧ķ ko̧ ilo̧ aōrōk, ilo̧ rej ejjeļok ilo̧ aō jeļā ilo̧ ro̧.

faq.q: Ro̧ group ro̧ ta?
faq.a: Ro̧ theme ro̧ rej kōmro̧ ro̧ ļo̧ķ ilo̧ jān ro̧ rej mōñā̧ jān ro̧ rej mōñā̧ ilo̧ aikwi ko̧: fruit, animals, flowers, weather, ways to travel, ro̧ rej mōñā̧ ilo̧ hot drink ilo̧ ro̧ rej mōñā̧ ilo̧ oven. Juon picture rej kōmro̧ ro̧ ļo̧ķ juon group jān.

faq.q: Ej free ilo̧ kōmro̧ ro̧ rej sign up?
faq.a: Eo, ej free, ilo̧ jaab account, sign-up ilo̧ download. Game ko̧ rej kōmro̧ ro̧ ļo̧ķ ilo̧ web browser ilo̧ phone, tablet ilo̧ computer.

odd-one-out.name: Juon ko̧ ej kōjrōk
odd-one-out.seoTitle: Jeļā picture ko̧ ilo̧ juon ko̧ ej kōjrōk jān ro̧ rej mōñā̧
odd-one-out.h1: Juon ko̧ ej kōjrōk: Jeļā picture ko̧ ilo̧ ejjeļok aikwi
odd-one-out.description: Picture ro̧ rūo ilo̧ wōt, ro̧ rej kōmro̧ ro̧ ļo̧ķ juon theme ko̧, bwe fruit ilo̧ weather. Bwebwenato ilo̧ picture ko̧ ej ļo̧ķ ko̧ ilo̧ ro̧ rej kōmro̧ ro̧ ļo̧ķ. Free, ejjeļok aikwi, jaab timer ilo̧ score.
odd-one-out.short: Bwebwenato picture ko̧ ej ļo̧ķ ko̧ ilo̧ ro̧ kōjrōk.
odd-one-out.intro: Three or four pictures, and all but one go together: fruit, perhaps, or ways to travel. Tap the picture that does not belong. If a picture does go with the others, the game simply says so and waits. After a quiet pause a hint names what the others share, and "Show me" points out the odd one at any time.
howTo: Jeļā picture rūo ilo̧ wōt. Rūo ko̧ ilo̧ wōt ej ļo̧ķ ko̧ ilo̧ jān ro̧ rej mōñā̧.
Look at the pictures together and talk about what most of them have in common.
Aō picture ko̧ ej ļo̧ķ ko̧ ilo̧ jān. Ilo̧ ro̧ ļo̧ķ ko̧ rej kōmro̧ ro̧ aō border ko̧ ilo̧ gold ilo̧ check mark.
Ilo̧ picture ro̧ rej kōmro̧ ro̧ ļo̧ķ ko̧ ilo̧ aikwi ko̧, game ko̧ rej kōmro̧ ro̧ ļo̧ķ ko̧ ilo̧ ro̧ ļo̧ķ ko̧ ilo̧ jān. Kōmro̧ ro̧ mōñā̧ ko̧ ilo̧ ro̧ ļo̧ķ jān.
Aō "Show me" ilo̧ ro̧ rej mōñā̧, ilo̧ "Another set" ilo̧ picture ro̧ ļo̧ķ ko̧ ilo̧ ro̧ ļo̧ķ jān.
tips: Kōmro̧ ro̧ ļo̧ķ ko̧ ilo̧ aikwi ilo̧ jeļā: "Apple ilo̧ pear ro̧ rūo ro̧ fruit. Bus ej ta?"
Ejjeļok aikwi ko̧ ilo̧ jān. Hint ko̧ rej kōmro̧ ro̧ ļo̧ķ theme ko̧ rej kōmro̧ ro̧ ļo̧ķ ilo̧ ro̧ kōjrōk, kōmro̧ ro̧ rej mōñā̧ ko̧ ilo̧ jān.
Picture ko̧ ilo̧ jān ej kōmro̧ ro̧ ļo̧ķ juon ko̧ ilo̧ aikwi: fruit ko̧ ro̧ rej mōñā̧, bus ko̧ ilo̧ ro̧ rej jeļā, rain ko̧ ilo̧ ro̧ rej jeļā.

faq.q: Ro̧ timer ilo̧ score?
faq.a: Jaab. Ro̧ clock, score, move counter ilo̧ losing jaab. Kōmro̧ ro̧ rej mōñā̧ ilo̧ ejjeļok aikwi, ilo̧ mōñā̧ ilo̧ kōjrōk ko̧ ilo̧ jān ejjeļok ko̧.

faq.q: Ej ko̧ ilo̧ aō picture ko̧ ilo̧ group rej kōmro̧ ro̧ ļo̧ķ?
faq.a: Ej jaab ko̧ ilo̧ aikwi. Jaab buzzer, red cross ilo̧ shaking. Game ko̧ rej kōmro̧ ro̧ ļo̧ķ picture ko̧, rej kōmro̧ ro̧ ļo̧ķ ko̧ ilo̧ aōrōk, ilo̧ rej ejjeļok ilo̧ aō jeļā ilo̧ ro̧.

faq.q: Ej ta ko̧ ilo̧ aō picture ko̧ ej ļo̧ķ?
faq.a: Ro̧ picture ro̧ rej kōmro̧ ro̧ ļo̧ķ ilo̧ theme ro̧ rej mōñā̧ jān ro̧ rej mōñā̧ ilo̧ aikwi ko̧: fruit, animals, flowers, weather, ways to travel, ro̧ rej mōñā̧ ilo̧ hot drink ilo̧ ro̧ rej mōñā̧ ilo̧ oven. Juon picture rej kōmro̧ ro̧ ļo̧ķ juon theme jān, ilo̧ juon ko̧ ej kōjrōk rej kōmro̧ ro̧ ļo̧ķ ilo̧ theme ko̧ jān.

faq.q: Kwōn̄ ļo̧k n̄an kōṃ̧m̧an̄, im kwōn̄ ṃōṃ̧ kōt ļo̧k?
faq.a: Eo, ej kōṃ̧m̧an̄ im ej jab kōṃ̧m̧an̄ ṃōṃ̧ kōt ļo̧k, ṃōṃ̧ kōt ļo̧k, ak ṃōṃ̧ kōt ṃ̧ōj. Ej m̧ōttan̄ in ļo̧k ippān̄ ko̧ ilo web browser ilo fon, tablet ak computer.

color-match.name: Color match
color-match.seoTitle: Color Match: a Gentle Picture Game
color-match.h1: Color Match: Find the Pictures of One Color
color-match.description: A large color with its name, and four or six pictures. Tap every picture that is that color. No timer, no score, and another color is simply named. Free to play and print.
color-match.short: Find every picture that is the same color as the one shown.
color-match.players: 1 or 2 people, or an adult and a child
color-match.intro: A large patch of color is shown with its name written beside it, and below it are four or six pictures. Tap every picture that is that color: a red apple and a red cup, for example. If a picture is another color, the game simply names it ("The pear is green.") and waits. "Show them" points out the pictures that match at any time, and "Another color" moves on.
howTo: Choose four or six pictures. Four is the simplest.
Look at the color and read its name together.
Tap every picture that is that color. Each one gets a thick border and a check mark.
If a picture is another color, the game says what color it is and waits. Take your time.
Tap "Show them" whenever you like, then "Another color" for a new color.
tips: Say the color out loud, then look around the room: what else is that color?
Use your own words if you like. "Tomato" or "sky" is as good as "red" or "blue".
Pointing works as well as tapping. Sit side by side so you can both see the screen.

faq.q: Is there a timer or a score?
faq.a: No. There is no clock, score, move counter or losing. You can stop at any moment, and stopping halfway is a perfectly good way to finish.

faq.q: What happens if a picture of another color is tapped?
faq.a: Nothing unpleasant. There is no buzzer, red cross or shaking. The game names the picture and its color, such as "The pear is green.", and waits for the next tap.

faq.q: Is color the only clue?
faq.a: No. The color is shown as a large patch and also written as a word, and every picture is named when it is tapped. Someone who finds a color hard to see can still play by reading the name.

faq.q: Is every picture really that color?
faq.a: The pictures are chosen by hand, and only ones where the main object is plainly one color. Pictures with several colors, such as a kite or a bee, are left out.

faq.q: Is there a paper version?
faq.a: Yes. A one-page sheet has four rows. Each row names a color and shows four pictures to point to or circle.

faq.q: Is it free, and do I need to sign up?
faq.a: Yes, it is free, and there is no account, sign-up or download. It works in the web browser on a phone, tablet or computer.

halves-match.name: Halves match
halves-match.seoTitle: Halves Match: a Gentle Picture Game
halves-match.h1: Halves Match: Join the Two Halves of a Picture
halves-match.description: The left halves of two or three pictures on one side, their right halves on the other. Tap a half, then the half that fits it. No timer, no score, and halves that do not fit simply separate. Free to play and print.
halves-match.short: Tap the two halves that fit together to make one picture.
halves-match.players: 1 or 2 people, or an adult and a child
halves-match.intro: Each picture is cut down the middle. The left halves of two or three pictures are in one column and their right halves, in a different order, are in the other. Tap a half on the left, then tap the half on the right that fits it, such as the spout of a kettle and its handle. Halves that fit are joined into a whole picture. Halves that do not fit simply separate again, and the game says so gently. "Show me" joins them all.
howTo: Choose two or three pictures. Two is the simplest.
Look at the left halves together. What do you think each one is part of?
Tap a half on the left, then tap the half on the right that fits it. It also works the other way round.
Halves that fit are joined, with a thick border and a check mark. Halves that do not fit separate again, and you can try another.
Tap "Show me" whenever you like, then "Another set" for new pictures.
tips: Trace the edge of a half with a finger. Where does the drawing reach the middle?
Say what you can see: "That one has a handle." There is no need to name every picture.
Pointing works as well as tapping. Sit side by side so you can both see the screen.

faq.q: Is there a timer or a score?
faq.a: No. There is no clock, score, move counter or losing. You can stop at any moment, and stopping halfway is a perfectly good way to finish.

faq.q: What happens if two halves do not fit?
faq.a: Nothing unpleasant. There is no buzzer, red cross or shaking. The two halves separate again and the game says, "Those two do not fit together. Try another." Nothing is counted.

faq.q: Are the pictures easy to tell apart?
faq.a: Yes. The pictures are chosen by hand, and two pictures on one board are never from the same group, such as two fruits or two animals. Pictures whose two halves look alike, such as the sun or a rainbow, are left out.

faq.q: Is there a paper version?
faq.a: Ee. Ej ļo̧k ļo̧k wōt jiban ruo̧ eo ej ļo̧k ļo̧k ļȩ jeļ kein jān kokorā ilo jerbal, im ļo̧k ļo̧k jān kōņȩ ilo jerbal eo ilo kajin ļȩ jeļ ilo wōt. Kōņ ļo̧k ļo̧k ilo wōt jeļ eo ilo ļo̧k ļo̧k ilo jeļ eo ilo dān ļȩ jeļ kein.

color-by-number.name: Color by number
color-by-number.seoTitle: Color by Number: a Calm Large-Print Fill Game
color-by-number.h1: Color by Number: Fill the Squares, Any Color You Like
color-by-number.description: A grid of large numbered squares and a key of four colors with their names. Choose a color, then tap squares to fill them. Any color is fine, there is no timer or score, and a button fills the rest by the numbers. Free to play and print.
color-by-number.short: Choose a color, then tap the numbered squares to fill them.
color-by-number.intro: A square grid of large squares, each with a number, and a key above it with four colors, each with its number and its written name. Choose a color from the key, then tap squares to fill them. The grid is 4 by 4 to start, with 6 by 6 and 8 by 8 when you want more squares. When every square has the color of its number, the grid is the picture on the sheet. Squares filled with any other color are simply your own picture, and the game says nothing about it. "Fill with the numbers" fills every empty square for you.
howTo: Choose the grid size. 4 by 4 has the biggest squares and is the simplest.
Look at the key above the grid. Each color has a number and a name, such as 1 Yellow.
Tap a color in the key, then tap the squares you would like to fill with it.
Use the color on the number, or any color you like. Both are fine.
Tap "Fill with the numbers" for the empty squares, "Clear" to start the grid again, or "Another picture" for a different one.
tips: Sit side by side and take turns: one person chooses the color, the other taps the square.
Talk about the colors: "I like the green." There is no need to name what the picture will be.
On a narrow screen the 8 by 8 grid scrolls sideways inside its own box. The squares stay a comfortable size.
The paper version works as well with pencils at a bedside table.

faq.q: Is there a timer or a score?
faq.a: No. There is no clock, score, move counter or losing. You can stop at any moment, and stopping halfway is a perfectly good way to finish.

faq.q: What if I use a different color from the number?
faq.a: Nothing happens, and that is the point. Any color can go in any square, and the game says nothing about it. When every square has the color of its number the game says so gently, and a picture in your own colors is just as good.

faq.q: Can the four colors be told apart by people with color-blindness?
faq.a: They were chosen to be. Every color also has a number, a written name and its own small shape, so color is never the only way to tell them apart. The four fills were checked with simulations of red-green and blue-yellow color blindness, and they also differ in lightness. A person with color blindness has not yet tried them, so please tell us if two look alike.

faq.q: Are the squares big enough for a tremor or a small screen?
faq.a: Every square is at least 48 pixels across, and 56 on the 4 by 4 grid. If a grid is too wide for the screen, it scrolls sideways inside its own box rather than shrinking the squares.

faq.q: Is there a paper version?
faq.a: Yes. A one-page sheet has a numbered grid and the key of four colors with their names. Color each square with a pencil of the color on its number, or any color you like.

faq.q: Is it free, and do I need to sign up?
faq.a: Yes, it is free, and there is no account, sign-up or download. It works in the web browser on a phone, tablet or computer.

pattern-maker.name: Pattern maker
pattern-maker.seoTitle: Pattern Maker: Design a Tile and Print the Pattern
pattern-maker.h1: Pattern Maker: Design a Tile, See It Repeat
pattern-maker.description: Change the squares of one small tile and watch it repeat into a pattern beside it, in four colors that each have a name and a shape. No timer or score. Free to play and print.
pattern-maker.short: Change the squares of a small tile and watch it repeat into a pattern.
pattern-maker.intro: A small tile of 3 by 3 squares, or 4 by 4 if you like, and beside it "your pattern": the same tile repeated in a block. Tap a square and it changes to the next of four colors, each with its own written name and shape. The pattern beside it changes at once. There is no right pattern and nothing is saved or sent. "Print my pattern" puts the repeated pattern on one page to keep, color in or give away.
howTo: Look at the tile and at your pattern beside it. They are the same tile, repeated.
Tap a square. It changes to the next color in the row of four colors above.
Keep tapping squares until the pattern looks the way you would like. Any pattern is a good one.
Tap "Surprise me" for a new tile, or "Start again" for a clear one. "Put it back" brings back the tile you had.
Tap "Print my pattern" if you would like it on paper, or tap Rest to stop.

Kōņa ņan juon ṃōn, juon lōn ak juon kōpuņ, ak kōņa ṃōn ko ļo ņe ej kōņa ņan lōn eo.

"Print the grid" ej paņ ļoñ grid ilo jeļā page ṃōñ kōṃkōṃ ļok ņan ļoñ rūkwōj pencil.

seated-toss.name: Seated toss tally
seated-toss.seoTitle: Seated Toss Tally: Jeļā ṃōñ bean-bag ņan rūkwōj
seated-toss.h1: Seated Toss Tally: Tōs ilo ļoñ table
seated-toss.description: Rūkwōj ilo table ej jeļā ļok tōs ļoñ soft bean bag ilo ļoñ big target ak kōṃman tally ilo paper. Jaab timed ak scored. Ej ṃōñ ļo ak print.

seated-toss.intro: Ļoñ jeļā tōs ņan rūkwōj ro ej kōṃōj ilo table. Kōṃlay printed target ilo table im jeļā tōs ļoñ soft bean bag, ak sock ro ej rōl, ņan ej lañ ilo rings. Tap "Print the target and tally sheet" im kōṃlay sheet ilo table ilo jet ļe.
Kōṃōj ilo ṃōñ, jet ilo jet ļe, im jeļā ṃōñ gentle toss ṃōj ṃōj. Jet ro ej pass.

tips: Sit close enough that a gentle underhand toss reaches the target without any stretching.
Talk about the toss, not the result: "Ej bwilo." Everyone cheers for every toss.
A rolled-up sock is light and easy to hold with a weak grip. Rest an arm on the table between turns.
If someone would rather watch, they can be the one who ticks the boxes.

faq.q: Is there a timer or a score?
faq.a: No. There is no clock, score, move counter or losing. You can stop at any moment, and stopping halfway is a perfectly good way to finish.

faq.q: Is it safe to toss a bean bag?
faq.a: It can be, with care. Use a bag with a sewn-shut cover or a rolled-up sock, never loose beans, rice or small fillings, which are a choking hazard for young children and for anyone who puts things in their mouth. Stay seated, toss gently toward the table and never toward a face, and keep an adult close by.

faq.q: Is anything counted or saved on the screen?
faq.a: No. The tally is only on paper, in boxes you tick yourselves. The page keeps no count and no timer, and nothing is saved or sent.

faq.q: What if someone cannot toss, or the bag lands off the sheet?
faq.a: Anyone may pass, and a bag that lands off the sheet is simply picked up for the next turn. Nothing is counted for it.

faq.q: What is on the printed sheet?
faq.a: One page: a large target with its three rings named Near, Middle and Far, a table with a column for each person and a row of small boxes to tick for each ring, and a line of safety advice. The names are written on the rings, so it works in black and white.

faq.q: Is it free, and do I need to sign up?

seasonal-pack.name: Seasonal puzzle pack

seasonal-pack.short: Three printable puzzles for the season you choose, or a rest day.

Stop whenever you like. A rest day is a good day too.
tips: Start with the puzzle that feels easiest today. One is enough.
Say the name of each picture aloud, if that helps.
Use crayons or pencils. Any colors are fine.
Keep the page for next time, or let it go.

faq.q: Is there a timer or a score?
faq.a: No. There is no clock, score, move counter or losing. You can stop at any moment, and stopping halfway is a perfectly good way to finish.

faq.q: Does the page know which season it is?
faq.a: No. You choose the season. The page does not look at the date or your location.

faq.q: Is there a score or a right answer?
faq.a: No. Nothing is timed, scored or checked on the screen, and no answers are shown. Each puzzle is only a picture to look at, join, circle or color.

faq.q: What if nobody wants puzzles today?
faq.a: Choose "Today is a rest day". The page then shows one calm line, and there is nothing to print or do.

faq.q: What is on the printed sheet?
faq.a: One page for the season you chose: its three puzzles, each with a short line of how to do it, and a line saying you can do one, two or all three.

faq.q: Is it free, and do I need to sign up?
faq.a: Yes, it is free, and there is no account, sign-up or download. It works in the web browser on a phone, tablet or computer.

decorate-a-card.name: Decorate a card together
decorate-a-card.seoTitle: Decorate a Card Together: a Printable Greeting Card
decorate-a-card.h1: Decorate a Card Together: Make One for Someone
decorate-a-card.description: Two people decorate a printed greeting card for a birthday, a thank you or just because, then write a message on the back together. Crayons or pens only. No timer or score. Free to print.
decorate-a-card.short: Decorate a printed greeting card together.
decorate-a-card.intro: A quiet making game for two people sitting side by side. You print one sheet, which folds in half to make a card. Choose an occasion, such as a birthday or a thank you, and decorate the front around its words. Then write a message on the back, together or one person writing what the other says. Use crayons, colored pencils or felt-tip pens. There is no right card, and nothing is timed, scored or sent.
howTo: Choose an occasion, then tap "Print the card".
Fold the sheet in half along the dashed line, so the front is on the outside.
One person decorates the front, and the other decorates the back, or you take turns on one side.
Write a message together. One person can write while the other says the words.
Stop whenever you like. A simple card is just as good as a detailed one.
tips: Start with the words on the front, then add leaves, stars or dots around them, one at a time.
If someone would rather not draw, they can choose the colors or write the message.
Say what you like about the other person's marks, rather than whether they are good.
Keep the card somewhere it can be given, or simply keep it on the table for now.

faq.q: Ej wōnj ilo kōnnaan ak ilo kōnāp?
faq.a: Aolep ejelok. Ejelok kaen, kōnaan, ļaļ ak jaļā. Kwō kōtaan ilo wōt eo kwōj kōtaan, ak kōtaan ilo wōt eo ej kōtaan ak e jilōk.

faq.q: Ej kwōj kōtaan jeļaļ ļōk, ļapļō ak jipan?
faq.a: Ejelok. Kōtaan ruo jeļaļ jipan, kōlor ak pen ļōk ej ļōmān. Ejelok ļōmān kōtaan, ļapļō ak jipan.

faq.q: Kwōj kōtaan jeļaļ eo ej ilo lisi?
faq.a: Kōtaan "Ej ļōmān" ak kōtaan bōk kōnāp ilo ruo, ak ļōk kōtaan jeļaļ ilo wōt jeļaļ.

faq.q: Ej kōmane, kōnāp ak kōnaan ilo ekran?
faq.a: Ejelok. Pēļe ej kōnaan ilo wōt jeļaļ ak lisi. Ejelok kōnāp, kōnaan ak kōtaan, ak ejelok jeļaļ eo ekwaļ.

faq.q: Ta eo ilo kaiboōk eo ej kōtaan?
faq.a: Ruo kiteb: jeļaļ eo ej kōtaan ruo, ilo wōt eo ilo ruo jeļaļ ak kōtaan ilo wōt, ak lisi ilo ruo eo ilo kōnāp. Kōmane ruo kōtaan ilo kōmān.

faq.q: Ej kōmane, ak kwōj kōtaan kōmane?
faq.a: Ejelok, ej kōmane, ak ejelok akō, kōtaan ak kōmane. Ej ļōk ilo web browser ilo kōmane, tablet ak kōmpiuta.

find-together.name: Find together
find-together.seoTitle: Find Together: Two People Find the Pairs
find-together.h1: Find Together: Two People, One Team
find-together.description: Two people share one screen and take turns turning over two picture cards to look for a pair. Pairs are found together and counted on one shared tally. Free to play, with no timer or score.
find-together.short: Take turns with someone beside you to find the picture pairs.
find-together.intro: The cards start with their pictures showing, or you can lay them face down. On your turn you turn over two cards. If they are a pair, you have found it together and the turn passes. If they are different, they stay face up until you press "Turn them back", so you can both look. Pass at any time. The tally at the top only goes up: the pairs you have found together.
howTo: Choose how many cards to use. Six cards, three pairs, is a calm place to start.
The screen says whose turn it is, with a circle for the first person and a square for the second.
Turn over two cards, one after the other. If they match, the pair is found together.
If they are different, press "Turn them back" when you are both ready. The turn then passes.
Either of you may press "Pass" at any time. Tap "Start again" for new cards, or tap Rest to stop.
tips: Sit side by side and name the pictures out loud together: "A teacup. Do you take milk in your tea?"
Let the person you care for do the tapping, even if it takes a while. Point rather than tap for them.
Choose "Cards face down" if you both enjoy turning cards over to find the pictures.
A person who tires easily can pass as often as they like. The pairs are still found together.

faq.q: Is there a winner, a timer or a score?
faq.a: No. There is no winner, because you find the pairs as a team. There is no clock, no score and no count of misses. The tally only counts the pairs you have found together, and you can stop at any moment.

faq.q: Do we have to remember where the pictures are?
faq.a: No. The game starts with every picture in view. With the cards face down, you can ask each other what you saw, or simply turn them over again.

faq.q: What happens when two cards are different?
faq.a: They stay face up, so you can both look at them, for as long as you need. Nothing turns them back by itself. When you are ready, press "Turn them back" and the turn passes to the other person.

faq.q: Is anything we play saved or sent?
faq.a: No. The cards stay on this page only. Nothing is saved, uploaded or counted, and it is gone when you close the page.

faq.q: Are the cards big enough for a tremor or a small screen?
faq.a: Every card is at least 64 pixels across and is as large as the screen allows. Keyboard and screen reader users hear each card by its place and its picture.

faq.q: Is it free, and do I need to sign up?
faq.a: Yes, it is free, and there is no account, sign-up or download. It works in the web browser on a phone, tablet or computer.

story-dice.name: Story dice
story-dice.seoTitle: Story Dice: a Picture Storytelling Game
story-dice.h1: Story Dice: Tell a Story with Pictures
story-dice.description: Three or four picture dice to tell a story with, in any order. No reading, no right answer, no timer and no score. Roll again, or pass. Free to play and print.
story-dice.short: Roll picture dice and tell a story together, in any order.
story-dice.players: 2 or more people, or an adult and a child
story-dice.intro: Ilo jitōk pikjā ko kōj kwōj jeļā, jān wōt jitōk. Kōṃṃan ilo ļōṃ ko ṃōṃṃa, ej ṃōṃṃa jān jeļā ko. Ilo ṃōṃṃa ej ṃōṃṃa ak ṃōṃṃa ko ṃōṃṃa, ej jitōk ilo ṃōṃṃa ko jen wōt. Ṃōṃṃa ko ej ṃōṃṃa ilo ṃōṃṃa ko. Ko ṃōṃṃa ej kōṃṃan, ak ñan ṃōṃṃa ko ej kōṃṃan ilo jeļā. Tap "Rōļ ilo ṃōṃṃa" bwe ļōṃ ko pikjā rejjien, im jeļā ṃōṃṃa ej kwōj ṃōṃṃa.
howTo: Jitōk ṃōṃṃa pikjā ko, ilo rūkwe ko ṃōṃṃa. Ṃōṃṃa ko ej ṃōṃṃa jitōk.
Kwōj lōmōr pikjā ko rejjien. Tap wōt bwe kwōj kōṃṃan ilo pikjā ko.
Kōṃṃan ļōṃ ṃōṃṃa ilo pikjā ko, ilo wōt ko ej kōṃṃan. Wōt jeļā ej ṃōṃṃa.
Wōt ej kwōj bōk jeļā. Tap "Bōk" bwe jeļā ko jān ej kōṃṃan.
Tap "Rōļ ilo ṃōṃṃa" bwe pikjā rejjien, ak tap Ṃōṃṃa bwe kwōj jeḷā.
tips: Kwōj jeļā ļōṃ ṃōṃṃa, ak kōj kwōj wōt ko: "Ilo ṃōṃṃa ko ej ṃōṃṃa jān ilo?"
Kōṃṃan ilo ṃōṃṃa ko wōt jān jeļā, ak ṃōṃṃa ko ej ṃōṃṃa. Ṃōṃṃa ko ej kōṃṃan.
Ṃōṃṃa ko ej ṃōṃṃa jān ṃōṃṃa ko jeļā. Pikjā ko ej ṃōṃṃa ko ṃōṃṃa.

faq.q: Ilo ṃōṃṃa ej timā ak ṃōṃṃa ko?
faq.a: Ṃōṃṃa. Ilo ṃōṃṃa ej timā, ṃōṃṃa ak ṃōṃṃa ko. Kwōj kōṃṃan jeļā ilo mōṃ ko, im bōk ilo mōṃ ko ej ṃōṃṃa ilo jeļā.

faq.q: Ñan ṃōṃṃa ko ļōṃ pikjā ko kōṃṃan?
faq.a: Ṃōṃṃa. Ļōṃ ko ej kōṃṃan ilo pikjā ko ļōṃ. Wōt ej kwōj tap, kōṃṃan, ak kōṃṃan ilo ṃōṃṃa ko pikjā ej ṃōṃṃa. Ṃōṃṃa ko ej kwōj kōṃṃan jeļā ṃōṃṃa.

faq.q: Ak ilo wōt ej ṃōṃṃa ñan kōṃṃan?
faq.a: Ej kwōj bōk ilo mōṃ ko, ilo ṃōṃṃa. Ļōṃ ko ej jeḷā, ak wōt jeļā ej kōṃṃan, ak kwōj rōļ ilo ṃōṃṃa.

faq.q: Ej ilo pepa?
faq.a: Ṃōṃṃa. Ilo pepa jeļā ej ilo pikjā ṃōṃṃa, ilo jeļā ilo kōṃṃan. Kwōj jitōk ilo rō ko, ak kwōj kōṃṃan pikjā ko jān ilo wōt.

faq.q: Is it free, and do I need to sign up?
faq.a: Yes, it is free, and there is no account, sign-up or download. It works in the web browser on a phone, tablet or computer.

word-and-picture-pairs.name: Jeļā ko ilo pikjā ak wōt
word-and-picture-pairs.seoTitle: Jeļā ko ilo pikjā ak wōt: Kōṃṃan wōt ñan pikjā
word-and-picture-pairs.h1: Jeļā ko ilo pikjā ak wōt: Kōṃṃan wōt ñan pikjā ko
word-and-picture-pairs.description: Kōṃṃan wōt Ingilish ñan pikjā ko, im ṃōṃṃa ļōṃ wōt ko kōṃṃan. Pikjā ej ṃōṃṃa ilo mōṃ, ak ṃōṃṃa ej timā, ṃōṃṃa ko ak ṃōṃṃa ko. Ej ṃōṃṃa ak ej ṃōṃṃa, ej bwe kwōj ṃōṃṃa.
word-and-picture-pairs.short: Kōṃṃan wōt ko ñan pikjā ko, im kōṃṃan ļōṃ ilo.
word-and-picture-pairs.players: Wōt ilo jeļā, ak ilo mōṃ ko ej jeḷā ilo kōṃṃan
word-and-picture-pairs.intro: Ilo pikjā ej ṃōṃṃa, ļōṃ ko wōt Ingilish ilo ṃōṃṃa ko ej kōṃṃan. Tap wōt, im pikjā ko, ak tap pikjā, im wōt ko. Ilo jeļā ko kōṃṃan ej kōṃṃan ilo mōṃ, im ilo wōt "Kōṃṃan". Tap "Ļōṃ ko kōṃṃan" bwe kwōj ļōṃ wōt ko. Ṃōṃṃa ko ej timā, im tap ko ej ṃōṃṃa ej jeḷā.
howTo: Jitōk pikjā ko, ṃōṃṃa ko ilo four ak six. Four ej ṃōṃṃa.
Tap wōt, im pikjā ko ej kōṃṃan. Ak tap pikjā ilo mōṃ, im wōt ko.
Ilo jeļā ko kōṃṃan ej kōṃṃan. Tap ko ej ṃōṃṃa ej jeḷā, kwōj tap wōt ko.
Tap "Ļōṃ ko kōṃṃan" ñan wōt ko bwe kwōj ļōṃ, ilo telefōn ko ej kōṃṃan.
Tap "Pikjā rejjien" ñan ṃōṃṃa, ak "Kōjā jeļā" bwe kōṃṃan ilo jeļā ko. "Bōk ilo" ej kōṃṃan ilo jeļā ko kōṃṃan.
tips: Ļōṃ ko wōt ko ilo jeļā, im kwōj kōṃṃan jān pikjā ko.
Ilo mōṃ ko ej jeḷā ilo kōṃṃan. Wōt ej kōṃṃan wōt ak pikjā.
Kwōj kōṃṃan wōt ko kwōj ṃōṃṃa ilo jeḷā, im ṃōṃṃa ko kōṃṃan ilo ṃōṃṃa.

faq.q: Ej timā ak ṃōṃṃa ko?
faq.a: Ṃōṃṃa. Ej timā, ṃōṃṃa, ṃōṃṃa ko, ak bōk ko. Kwōj bōk ilo mōṃ ko, im bōk ilo mōṃ ko ej ṃōṃṃa ilo jeļā.

faq.q: Ej ñan ṃōṃṃa ko?
faq.a: It is made for adults learning or relearning English words, and for families playing side by side. It is not written for children.

faq.q: Ak ilo telefōn ej ṃōṃṃa ļōṃ wōt?
faq.a: Tap "Ļōṃ ko kōṃṃan" ej kōṃṃan ilo browser ko ṃōṃṃa. Ak browser ej ṃōṃṃa ļōṃ, ṃōṃṃa ko ej ṃōṃṃa ilo ṃōṃṃa ko, im jeļā ej kōṃṃan ilo ṃōṃṃa.

faq.q: Ej ilo pepa?
faq.a: Ṃōṃṃa. Ilo pepa jeļā ej ilo six pikjā ak six wōt, bwe kwōj kōṃṃan ak kōṃṃan ilo lain.

faq.q: Ej timā, ak ej ṃōṃṃa ilo ṃōṃṃa ko?
faq.a: Ṃōṃṃa, ej timā. Ej ṃōṃṃa ilo ṃōṃṃa, ilo ṃōṃṃa ko, ak ilo ṃōṃṃa ko. Ej kōṃṃan ilo web browser ilo telefōn, tablet ak kompiuta.

sort-together.name: Ajeji ippān doon
sort-together.seoTitle: Jeļā ko kōṃṃan: Kōṃṃan jeļā ñan ṃōṃṃa
sort-together.h1: Ajeji Ippān Doon: M̧akūtkūt in Kōlaajrak Pija ko
sort-together.description: Tap a picture, then the basket it belongs in: kitchen or garden, fruit or animals. A calm, free sorting game for adults and families.
sort-together.short: Kōkoba kajjojo pija ilo bōkēj eo an: jikin kōmat ak jikin kōkkat, im bar jet.
sort-together.intro: Ajej im kōlaajrak men ko ej juon jerbal in aolep raan me kōj jeļā kake im eṃṃan ilo kōļmenļo̧kjeņ, āinwōt kakkwōni men ko jān jitoo̧ ak kobaiki juuj ko. Jikōt juon pija, innām jikōt bōkēj eo me ej deļo̧ñ ie. Ejjeļo̧k kabbūro̧kļo̧k im ejjeļo̧k iien bōd.
howTo: Kāālet juon katak: jikin kōmat im jikin kōkkat, leen wōjke im menninmour ko, ak m̧weo im ito-itak.
Jikōt juon pija. Enaaj orool kōn koo̧l.
Jikōt bōkēj eo me ej deļo̧ñ ie. Pija eo enaaj etal ñan bōkēj eo.
Ñe ej deļo̧ñ ilo bar juon bōkēj, kakkōl eo enaaj ba ilo ineenne im kōttar.
Ñe aolep pija ko em̧ōj kōlaajraki, lale bōkēj ko kajjojo ippān doon.
tips: Ilo mour eo ad, eñin ejjeļo̧k uwaak ebōd. Ñe armej eo ej ba bwe kān in dānnin ej ijo jikin kōmat, kajjitōk kōn unin. Emaroñ naaj waļo̧k juon bwebwenato eṃṃan.
Kōjerbal pija ko ñan kōm̧m̧an kajjitōk: "Ta ko kwōar katti ilo jikin kōkkat eo am̧?"
Ajej men ko rōm̧ool, āinwōt aitiñ im boorki ak batin ko kōn kalōr ko aer, ej juon m̧akūtkūt ekanooj eṃṃan eļakin am̧ kile koot.

faq.q: Ewōr ke kilōk ak joko̧o̧?
faq.a: Jaab. Ejjeļo̧k kilōk, joko̧o̧, bōnbōn in m̧akūtkūt, ak luji. Kwōmaroñ kakkije ilo jabdewōt iien, im am̧ bōjrak ilojitōļ ej juon wāween ekanooj eṃṃan ñan kōm̧m̧an jem̧ļo̧kin.

faq.q: Etke ajeji im kōlaajraki?
faq.a: Elōñ armej rej m̧ōnōnō kōn kōlaajrak kōnke ej āinwōt jerbal eṃṃan im kōj jeļā kake. Ebar bidodo ñan kōnono kōn pija ko ilo iien am̧ kōm̧m̧ane.

faq.q: Ejjeļo̧k ke wōņāān, im ij aikuj ke jaini?
faq.a: Aet, ejjeļo̧k wōņāān, im ejjeļo̧k akaun, jaini, ak kōdāik m̧weiuk. Ej jerbal wōt ilo browser ilo talboon, tablet, ak kom̧pootōr.

picture-puzzle.name: Pajōl in pija
picture-puzzle.seoTitle: Jeļā ko ilo pikjā: 4 ak 9 jeļā
picture-puzzle.h1: Pajōl in Pija: Juon Jigsaw Ebidodo
picture-puzzle.description: Jeļā ko ilo pikjā ñan ṃōṃṃa: 4 ak 9 jeļā, pikjā rejjien ej ṃōṃṃa, im tap rūkwe ñan kōṃṃan. Kwōj ṃōṃṃa ilo pikjā ṃōṃṃa, ej ilo mōṃ ko. Timā, ej ṃōṃṃa ilo timā.
picture-puzzle.short: Jikōt ruo m̧ōttan ñan kōkōkōti m̧ae iien pija eo ej koba.
picture-puzzle.intro: Pikjā ṃōṃṃa ej kōṃṃan ilo 4 ak 9 jeļā, im ej kōṃṃan. Pikjā rejjien ej ṃōṃṃa bwe ilo jeļā. Tap jeļā, im jeļā ṃōṃṃa, im ej kōṃṃan. Ṃōṃṃa ej ṃōṃṃa ilo ṃōṃṃa ko. Kwōj ṃōṃṃa ilo pikjā ko ṃōṃṃa, ej ilo mōṃ ko, im ej ṃōṃṃa ilo jeļā.
howTo: Kāālet juon pija im 4 ak 9 m̧ōttan ko. Emān ej juon jinoin ebidodo im ineenne.
Kalimjek aolepen pija eo ilōñ.
Jikōt juon m̧ōttan, innām jikōt ijo ej aikuj etal ie. M̧ōttan ko ruo rej kōkōkōt jikier.
M̧ōttan ko rej pād ilo jikin eṃṃan enaaj wōr juon māāk jidik kōn check mark.
Ñe ebo̧o̧r aolepen pija eo, m̧ōnōnō kake ippān doon, innām kāālet bar juon.
tips: Am̧ jikōt ruo m̧ōttan ñan kōkōkōti ekanooj bidodoļo̧k jān am̧ karōkeki ñan elōñ armej.
Kōnono kōn pija eo ilo an koba: "Eñin wōp eo ekilmir."
Juon jigsaw in alal eṃool me ewōr 12 ñan 24 m̧ōttan kileplep ej juon m̧akūtkūt ekanooj eṃṃan ilo tebōļ.

faq.q: Ewōr ke kilōk ak joko̧o̧?
faq.a: Jaab. Ejjeļo̧k kilōk, joko̧o̧, bōnbōn in m̧akūtkūt, ak luji. Kwōmaroñ kakkije ilo jabdewōt iien, im am̧ bōjrak ilojitōļ ej juon wāween ekanooj eṃṃan ñan kōm̧m̧an jem̧ļo̧kin.

faq.q: Ij aikuj ke karōkeki m̧ōttan ko?
faq.a: Jaab. Jikōt juon m̧ōttan, innām jikōt bar juon, bwe erro ren kōkōkōt jikier. Men in ebidodoļo̧k ñan pein armej me rej uurwōd ak ilo koot jiddik.

faq.q: Ejjeļo̧k ke wōņāān, im ij aikuj ke jaini?
faq.a: Aet, ejjeļo̧k wōņāān, im ejjeļo̧k akaun, jaini, ak kōdāik m̧weiuk. Ej jerbal wōt ilo browser ilo talboon, tablet, ak kom̧pootōr.

finish-the-saying.name: Kakūrm̧ool kōnono eo
finish-the-saying.seoTitle: Kōṃṃan ļōṃ ko: Jeļā ko ļōṃ ko ṃōṃṃa
finish-the-saying.description: Kōnono ko an Merike me elōñ rej jeļā kaki im ejako naan eo āliktata, āinwōt "A penny saved is a penny ___". Jikōt juon kāālet ak kwaļo̧k jem̧ļo̧kin, innām kōnono kake.
finish-the-saying.short: Kakūrm̧ool kōnono ko me kōj jeļā kaki ippān doon, innām kōnono kaki.
finish-the-saying.intro: Jabōnkōnnaan ko etto rej pād wōt ilo aolepen mour eo ad. Kajjojo kaat ej kwaļo̧k juon kōnono me ejako naan eo āliktata, jilu kāālet ko, im juon batin me ej ba "Kwaļo̧k jem̧ļo̧kin". Elikin an jem̧ļo̧k, ewōr juon kajjitōk ineenne me ej kajjitōk bwe kōm̧in bwebwenato kake.
howTo: Riiti kōnono eo aolepe ilo ainikien eļap.
Jikōt naan eo me ej kakūrm̧oole, ak jikōt "Kwaļo̧k jem̧ļo̧kin".
Bar riiti aolepen kōnono eo im bwebwenato kake kōn kajjitōk eo.
Jikōt "Kōnono eo laļļo̧k" ñe kwōm̧ōj am̧ pojak.
tips: Riiti ilo m̧ōkajdikdik im kakkije m̧ōk mokta jān naan eo āliktata. Ekka an armej ba naan eo mokta jān am̧ riiti.

coloring.intro: Peij ko ippān m̧ōttan ko rōļap im remeļeļe: juon ut ilo pot, juon em̧, juon kōb in tii, juon peba, im juon wa in jerak. Jidik juon kōļọr, innām jidik juon m̧ōttan pija eo n̄an kobaiki. Ejjeḷọk kōļọr ebōd.

Jidik juon kōļọr. Kajjojo kōļọr ewōr etan jeje ioon.
Jidik juon m̧ōttan pija eo n̄an kobaiki kōn kōļọr eo.

conversation-cards.name: Kaad ko n̄an bwebwenato
conversation-cards.seoTitle: Ilo̧ kōṃṃan: Kāāļ̣ pikjā ṃōṃan ro̧ ṃōṃan
conversation-cards.description: Kāāļ̣ pikjā ilo̧ kōṃṃan ņan ro̧ ṃōṃan, ro̧ ṃaroñ, ro̧ ṃōṃan ṃōttan, ilo̧ ro̧ ko ilo̧ dementia. Jaḷȩ ilo̧ jān ļōļ̧ ko, ṃakūn aolep ļōļ̧ bōlōk.
conversation-cards.short: Kaad in pija ippān kajjitōk ko repeļļọk im reaenaj. Ejjeḷọk test.
conversation-cards.intro: Kajjojo kaad ej kobaik juon pija em̧ōj jeḷā kake ippān juon kūr epeļļọk n̄an bwebwenato, āinwōt “Kōļap eo kwoj iakwe eļaptata ej ta?” Ejjeḷọk uwaak ejejjet im ejjeḷọk men eo aikuj kememej. Kāālet juon unin ak kobaiki aolep.
howTo: Kāālet juon unin, ak likūt “All cards”.
Riiti kajjitōk eo eļap ainikien im lale pija eo ippān doon.
Roñjake, kwalọk uwaak eo am̧, im likūt bwebwenato eo en etal wōt.
Jidik “Next card” ñe kwoj pojak, ak pād wōt ippān juon kaad joñan wōt am̧ kōņaan.
Jidik “Print all cards” n̄an bukwe juon set in kaad in pepe.
tips: Uwaak kajjitōk eo kwe barāinwōt. Ej āinwōt bwebwenato, ejjab juon interview.
Ļoor bwebwenato eo, ejjab meḷeḷe ko rejejjet. Ñe men ko rej oktak, ej em̧m̧an wōt.
Ñe juon kaad ej tōpar juon men eburom̧ōj, kile eņjake eo im jouj im jilkinļọk n̄an bar juon kaad ilo juon wāween eaenaj.

faq.q: Etke ejjeḷọk kajjitōk āinwōt “Kwoj ke kememej…?”

photo-pairs.name: Pea in pija
photo-pairs.seoTitle: Kōm̧m̧an juon Ikkiil in Kapea jān Pija in Baam̧le ko
photo-pairs.h1: Pea in Pija: Kapea Pija ko Am̧ Make
photo-pairs.description: Kōm̧m̧an pija ko an baam̧le eo am̧ bwe ren erom juon ikkiil in kapea eo aenōm̧m̧an. Kāālōt 2 n̄an 6 pija ilo device eo am̧; rej pād wōt ilo browser eo am̧ im reban upload e n̄an jabdewōt jikin.

photo-pairs.intro: Kōṃṃan ruo tokjel ro̧ ko pikjā ṃōṃan ko̧ ņan telefōn, tablet ak kompiuta, im pikjā ro̧ ṃōṃan ṃōttan jān ilo̧ ilo̧ pikjā kōṃṃan ņan jerbal ko. Pikjā ro̧ kōṃṃan ilo̧ peļ̧ jān ilo̧ kāāļ̣ ņan ṃōṃan ko, ak jaḷȩ kōmaan, jaḷȩ kāāļ̣, ak jaḷȩ jiṃ̧ jān ilo̧ kōṃṃan. Pikjā ro̧ ṃōṃan ṃōttan ilo̧ ņan ṃōṃan ko̧, ak jaḷȩ ļōļ̧ ņan kōmaan ilo̧ ņan pikjā. Im kōmaan kōṃṃan ilo̧ pikjā ṃōṃan ko̧ ko̧ jān ko̧ jān ilo̧ kōṃṃan ļōļ̧ ņan ṃōṃan.
howTo: Ṃōṃan “Kāāļ̣ pikjā” im kāāļ̣ ruo tokjel ro̧ ko pikjā.
Pikjā jeṃṃa ņan ruo jeṃṃa. Ṃōṃan ilo̧ ta̧ŋ ņan pikjā, ak ṃōṃan ilo̧ pikjā ņan jeṃṃa.
Kōṃṃan ruo tokjel ro̧ ko ilo̧ bāāļ̣ ņan pikjā. Ļōļ̧ ņan bōlōk kāāļ̣ jaḷȩ.
Kōṃṃan ilo̧ pikjā ņan ṃōṃan ļōļ̧ ņan ro̧ kōṃṃan ilo̧ ta̧ŋ ņan pikjā.
Ṃōṃan ṃōttan, ṃōṃan ilo̧ ilo̧ “Ṃakūn pikjā” im kōmaan ṃōttan. Ļōļ̧ ṃakūn jaḷȩ ṃōṃan.
tips: Kāālōt pija ko rekkaļ kōn men ko rem̧m̧an im meļeļe kake: juon menninmour ilo m̧weo, juon jikin kallib, juon jikin kōņaan, raan in m̧are.
Pija in ijoko im m̧weiuk ko remaron̄ bidodoļo̧k jān turin mej, im rej bōkļo̧k inepata in aikuj ņaetan armej ro.
Jab kōjerbal pija ko an ro em̧ōj aer mej n̄e remaron̄ kōm̧m̧an būrom̧ōj ilo iddik, ijellokin n̄e kwojeļā bwe rej bōktok kaenōm̧m̧an.

faq.q: Pija ko aō rej ke upload n̄an jabdewōt jikin?
faq.a: Jaab. Peej in ej riiti pija ko kwoj kāālōti ilo browser eo am̧ im kwaļo̧k er ilo screen eo am̧. Rejjab jilkinļo̧k n̄an kōm ak n̄an bar jabdewōt armej, im renaaj jako n̄e kwoj kōļpej ak bar kōkāāl peej in.

faq.a: Jaab. Ejjeļo̧k awa, pūōn, kōrwa in makūtkūt, ak luuj. Kwomaron̄ bōjrak ilo jabdewōt iien, im kabōjrak ilo lukwōļpān ej juon wāween em̧m̧an n̄an kadikļo̧k.

picture-bingo.name: Bingo in pija
picture-bingo.seoTitle: Bingo ņan pikjā ņan kāāļ̣ ņan pepa rūkkā
picture-bingo.h1: Bingo in Pija n̄an Kumi ko
picture-bingo.description: Bingo ņan pikjā ņan kāāļ̣ ņan pepa jaḷȩ jān ro̧ ṃōṃan, ro̧ ṃōṃan ṃōttan, im ilo̧ ṃōṃan ņan kōṃṃan. Pikjā ṃōttan ņan kōṃṃan, 9 ak 16 kōb, im ro̧ kōṃṃan ņan kāāļ̣ ņan jān ilo̧ ṃōṃan ko.
picture-bingo.short: Kaat in bingo in pija ko maron̄ printi im juon jikin kūr kilep ilo screen n̄an kumi ko.
picture-bingo.intro: Bingo eo em̧m̧an kōn pija ijellokin nōmba ko, bwe ejjeļo̧k en aikuj riiti jeje jiddik ko. Printi juon koba in kaat ko reoktak jān doon, innem kōjerbal ri-kūraan eo ilo screen n̄an kwaļo̧k kajjojo pija kilep ilo TV, laptop, ak tablet.
howTo: Kāālōt 9 ak 16 square ilo kajjojo kaat im jete armej renaaj ikkure.
Jitōn̄e "Printi kaat ko". Kajjojo kaat eoktak.
Kōppeļļo̧k ri-kūraan eo ilo screen kilep. Jitōn̄e "Pija eo juon" n̄an kwaļo̧k kajjojo pija kōn etan.
Ri-ikkure ro rej kalbubuuke pija eo ej kapea ilo kaat eo aer kōn kōba, batōn, ak māāk.
Aolep ro rej kobaik juon lain, ak kaat eo aolepen, renaaj bōk kamm̧oolol. Ejjeļo̧k ri-luuj ilo wāween in: wōnm̧aanļo̧k wōt ilo ikkure m̧ae aolep ewōr aer lain.
tips: Kōjerbal m̧weiuk ko rekilep āinwōt checkers ak kape in bōto̧o̧l. Batōn jiddik remaron̄ pen an pei bōki.
Kūr etan pija eo im ba jidik men kake: "Juon wa in kōto. Wōn eo em̧ōj an pād ilo wa in kōto?"
Kōkōn̄ōltok armej ro epen aer lolo epaake screen eo, im kobaiki ri-jiban̄ ro ippān ri-ikkure ro rej aikuji.
Ratimjuon square ebwe n̄an elōn̄ kumi. Kōm̧m̧an bwe iien ikkure eo en pād ioon 20 n̄an 30 minit.

faq.q: Ewi wāween aō kōm̧m̧an bingo in pija ilo juon jikin lale rūtto ro?
faq.a: Printi juon kaat n̄an kajjojo ri-ikkure, likūt ri-kūraan eo ilo screen eo ekileptata ippāmi, im kūr pija ko ilo m̧ōkadik im ba etan kajjojo. Ikkure m̧ae aolep ewōr aer lain, bwe ejjeļo̧k en kootļo̧k.

faq.q: Ejjeļo̧k ke oņean an print?
faq.a: Aet. Printi jete wōt kaat ko kwōj aikuji, jete alen wōt am̧ kōņaan, n̄an kōjerbal make ak ilo kumi.

faq.q: Armej remaron̄ ke ikkure meñe rejjab riit?
faq.a: Aet. Kajjojo square ej juon pija ekilep, kōn etan i laļin n̄an ro rekōņaan naan ko.

picnic-planner.name: Kōṃṃan ņan ṃōṃan ilo̧ bāāļ̣ ņan kōb
picnic-planner.seoTitle: Kōṃṃan ņan ṃōṃan ilo̧ bāāļ̣ ņan kōb: Kāāļ̣ pikjā ņan jerbal
picnic-planner.h1: Kōṃṃan ņan ṃōṃan ilo̧ bāāļ̣ ņan kōb: Kāāļ̣ pikjā, im ṃōṃan ṃōttan ro̧ jeṃṃa
picnic-planner.description: Choose food and things-to-do pictures for a picnic, then play a gentle matching round with them. Nothing is timed. Free to play and print.
picnic-planner.short: Kāāļ̣ pikjā ņan mōj ak ņan jerbal ņan ṃōṃan ilo̧ bāāļ̣ ņan kōb, im kōṃṃan jeṃṃa.
picnic-planner.players: Ļōļ̧ ṃōṃan ilo̧ ruo ro̧ ko jeṃṃa
picnic-planner.intro: Ṃōṃan pikjā ņan mōj ak ņan jerbal ņan ṃōṃan ilo̧ kōb ņan ṃōṃan, ņan jaḷȩ ruo tokjel. Ilo̧ kōṃṃan ņan kōb ņan ṃōṃan ko, ak ilo̧ kōb ņan aolep ļōļ̧ ņan ṃōṃan ko. Ṃōṃan “Kōṃṃan ilo̧ kōb ro̧ kōṃṃan”, ak ko ņan kōṃṃan ilo̧ ṃōṃan ņan jeṃṃa ilo̧ pikjā ņan kōb. Pikjā ro̧ ko jaḷȩ kāāļ̣ ak jaḷȩ ṃakūn. “Pirint kōṃṃan ņan kōb” ilo̧ ṃakūn ļōļ̧ ņan ṃōṃan ko ņan pepa.
howTo: Ṃōṃan pikjā ņan mōj ak jerbal ņan ṃōṃan. Ilo̧ kōb.
Ṃōṃan pikjā ilo̧ kōb ņan kāāļ̣ ļōļ̧ ṃakūn.
Kāāļ̣ ruo tokjel ro̧ ko, im ṃōṃan “Kōṃṃan ilo̧ kōṃṃan ņan kōb”.
Ṃōṃan ruo pikjā ņan jeṃṃa. Pikjā ro̧ ko jaḷȩ kāāļ̣, jaḷȩ kōmaan ņan kōṃṃan.
Tap "Print our picnic list" for a paper checklist to take with you.
tips: Kōṃṃan ilo̧ ro̧ ko kōṃṃan ņan ṃōṃan ṃōttan ļōļ̧ ņan ṃōṃan ko, im kāāļ̣ pikjā ilo̧ jeṃṃa.
Kōṃṃan ilo̧ pikjā ņan kōb: “Ej kōmaan ņan ṃōṃan ṃakūn ilo̧ ṃōṃan?”
Ilo̧ pepa, ilo̧ bāāļ̣ ro̧ ko ņan kōṃṃan ņan ṃōṃan, ak ņan ṃōṃan ilo̧ ņan ṃōṃan ilo̧ ilo̧ ņan ṃōttan.

faq.q: Ej ṃōṃan ṃakūn, ṃōṃan ņan bōlōk, ak ro̧ ko ṃōṃan?
faq.a: Jaḷȩ. Jaḷȩ ṃakūn ak jaḷȩ bōlōk, im jaḷȩ ro̧ ko ṃōṃan. Kōṃṃan ilo̧ jeṃṃa ṃōṃan jaḷȩ ṃōṃan ņan jeṃṃa, jaḷȩ ṃōṃan ṃōttan.

faq.q: Ej kōṃṃan ņan mōj?
faq.a: Jaḷȩ. Ej kōṃṃan ņan pikjā ņan ṃōṃan ilo̧ bāāļ̣ ņan kōb, ņan kōṃṃan ilo̧ ṃōṃan ak ņan pepa. Ej jaḷȩ kōṃṃan ņan ro̧ ko ṃōṃan ņan mōj ko.

faq.q: Ej pikjā ro̧ ko kāāļ̣ ilo̧ ta̧ŋ, ak ro̧ ko kōṃṃan?
faq.a: Jaḷȩ. Kōb ņan ṃōṃan ilo̧ ta̧ŋ ņan pēj ko. Jaḷȩ kōṃṃan, jaḷȩ kōṃṃan ilo̧ ta̧ŋ, ak ṃōṃan ilo̧ ṃakūn ņan kōṃṃan.

faq.q: Ej pepa ņan kōṃṃan?
faq.a: Ej. “Pirint kōṃṃan ņan kōb” pirint ruo pēj, ilo̧ A4 ak US Letter. Ej pikjā ro̧ kāāļ̣ ļōļ̧ ņan bōlōk ruo tokjel, im bāāļ̣ ņan ṃōṃan ilo̧ ņan kōṃṃan.

faq.q: Ej jaḷȩ ṃōṃan, ak ṃōṃan ṃōttan ļōļ̧ ņan kōṃṃan?
faq.a: Ej jaḷȩ ṃōṃan. Jaḷȩ kōṃṃan, jaḷȩ kōṃṃan ņan pepa, ak jaḷȩ kōṃṃan ņan kōmaan. Ej kōṃṃan ilo̧ browser ilo̧ telefōn, tablet ak kompiuta.

scrapbook.name: Scrapbook
scrapbook.seoTitle: Scrapbook: Kōṃṃan ņan pikjā ṃōṃan ilo̧ kōṃṃan, pēj ko pēj
scrapbook.h1: Scrapbook: Kōṃṃan pikjā im bāāļ̣ ņan kōṃṃan, im ṃōṃan ņan pēj
scrapbook.description: Kāāļ̣ ruo ilo̧ tokjel ro̧ ko pikjā ṃōṃan ilo̧ ṃakūn ņan kōṃṃan, im ṃōṃan ṃōttan ilo̧ bāāļ̣ ņan ta̧ŋ. Jaḷȩ kōṃṃan ilo̧ ta̧ŋ. Jaḷȩ kōṃṃan ņan pepa ņan ṃakūn.
scrapbook.short: Kōṃṃan ilo̧ pikjā ṃōṃan ņan kōṃṃan jeṃṃa, ilo̧ ņan ṃōṃan ilo̧ kōb.
scrapbook.players: Ļōļ̧ ṃōṃan ilo̧ ruo ro̧ ko jeṃṃa
scrapbook.intro: Kāāļ̣ ruo tokjel ro̧ ko pikjā ṃōṃan ilo̧ ilo̧ kōb. Pikjā jeṃṃa ņan pēj ilo̧ kōb, ṃakūn ņan kōṃṃan, im ilo̧ bāāļ̣ ņan kōṃṃan ņan ṃōṃan ko. Ṃōṃan pēj ilo̧ ṃōṃan ko ak ilo̧ kōṃṃan ņan pellȩ, im ṃōṃan “Kōṃṃan jeṃṃa” ņan kōṃṃan ilo̧ pikjā ak bāāļ̣ kōṃṃan. Pikjā ṃōṃan ilo̧ ilo̧ kōb, jaḷȩ kōṃṃan, im kōb jaḷȩ kōṃṃan ilo̧ ta̧ŋ. “Pirint scrapbook” pirint pikjā ak bāāļ̣ ilo̧ pēj ko pēj, im numbu ņan pēj.
howTo: Ṃōṃan “Kāāļ̣ pikjā” im kāāļ̣ ruo tokjel ro̧ ko pikjā. Kōṃṃan ilo̧ ro̧ ko ṃōttan ņan ilo̧ pikjā ņan ro̧ ko jaḷȩ jeṃṃa.
Ṃōṃan pēj ilo̧ “Pēj ņan mōṃṃan” im “Pēj ņan jeļā”, ak ilo̧ bōtān ņan kiiļ̧ ņan jouj ilo̧ kāāļ̣ ļōļ̧ ņan ṃōṃan.
Kōṃṃan bāāļ̣ ņan kōṃṃan ilo̧ pikjā ņan kōṃṃan. Ṃōṃan “Jeļā ņan ṃakūn” ak “Jeļā ņan kōṃṃan” ņan ṃōṃan ṃōttan ilo̧ ta̧ŋ.
Ṃōṃan “Kōṃṃan jeṃṃa” ņan jaḷȩ bōtān ņan ṃōṃan ilo̧ ṃōṃan kōmaan, im kōṃṃan ilo̧ kōb ilo̧ ta̧ŋ.
Ṃōṃan “Pirint scrapbook” ņan pepa ņan ṃakūn, ak “Kāāļ̣ kōb” ņan kōṃṃan. Jaḷȩ kōṃṃan.
tips: Choose photos of happy, familiar things: a garden, a pet, a favorite place. Talk about each page as you turn it.
Let the person say a few words for each page, even a single word, and write them down exactly as they say them.
On paper, the printed pages can go into a folder, and the family can add their own pictures and notes around them.

faq.q: Ȩ̄ ilo̧ ... ṃōṃṃan̄, ṃōṃṃan̄, ṃōṃṃan̄?
faq.a: Ṃōṃṃan̄. Ṃōṃṃan̄ ... ṃōṃṃan̄, ṃōṃṃan̄ ... ṃōṃṃan̄. Nummer ṃōṃṃan̄ ṃōṃṃan̄ ... ṃōṃṃan̄.

faq.q: Ȩ̄ fōto̧ im̧ ... ṃōṃṃan̄ ... ṃōṃṃan̄ ... ṃōṃṃan̄?
faq.a: No. The photos are read by this page only, and they are not uploaded, stored or sent anywhere. The captions are kept only while the page is open. When you close the page, the book is gone.

faq.q: Ȩ̄ kōm̧ ... ṃōṃṃan̄ ṃōṃṃan̄?
faq.a: Yes. "Print the scrapbook" prints one photo and its caption on each page, with page numbers. Choose A4 or US Letter in the print dialog.

faq.q: Ȩ̄ ṃōṃṃan̄ ... ṃōṃṃan̄ ... ṃōṃṃan̄?
faq.a: Yes, it is free, and there is no account, sign-up or download. It works in the web browser on a phone, tablet or computer.

collage-board.name: Collage board
collage-board.seoTitle: Collage Board: Two People Place Pictures in Turns
collage-board.h1: Collage Board: Place Pictures on One Board, in Turns
collage-board.description: Two people take turns placing cut-out pictures on one shared board. Tap a cut-out, then an empty place. No timer or score. Free to play and print.
collage-board.short: Take turns placing pictures on one shared board.
collage-board.intro: Two people sit side by side with one board of twelve places and a tray of eight cut-out pictures. Tap a cut-out, then tap an empty place, and the picture goes there. The turn then passes to the other person. Each person's pictures carry their own shape, a circle or a square, so the board shows who placed what without relying on color. Either person may pass, and one step can be taken back. Nothing is timed, scored or saved. "Print the board" prints the empty board and the pictures to cut out.
howTo: Tap a cut-out in the tray. It shows "Chosen" while it is selected.
Tap an empty place on the board. The cut-out goes there, and the turn passes.
Either person can tap Pass at any time, or "Take back the last piece" to undo one step.
Tap "Another set of pictures" for a different tray. Pictures already on the board stay where they are.
Tap "Start again" to clear the board, and "Put it back" if you change your mind.
tips: Say the name of each picture as it goes down, such as "the teacup goes by the house". Talking makes it a shared activity.
Let the two people take turns choosing the cut-out as well as the place, so each has a say.
On paper, cut out the eight pictures with an adult helping, then place them on the printed boxes.

faq.q: Is there a timer, a score or a winner?
faq.a: No. Nothing is timed, scored or counted, and nobody wins. A full board is simply one with a picture in every place.

faq.q: Are the pictures we place saved or sent?
faq.a: No. The board stays on this page only. It is not saved, uploaded or counted, and it is gone when you close the page.

faq.q: How do we tell whose picture is whose?
faq.a: Each person has a shape. The first person's pictures have a circle in the corner, and the second person's have a square, with each name shown above the board.

faq.q: Is there a paper version?
faq.a: Yes. "Print the board" prints the empty board as twelve boxes, with the eight pictures below at the same size, and the cutting line. An adult can do the cutting.

faq.q: Is it free, and do I need to sign up?
faq.a: Yes, it is free, and there is no account, sign-up or download. It works in the web browser on a phone, tablet or computer.

garden-planner.name: Garden planner
garden-planner.seoTitle: Garden Planner: Lay Out a Plot from Plant Pictures
garden-planner.h1: Garden Planner: Choose Pictures and Lay Out a Plot
garden-planner.description: Choose pictures of plants and garden things, then place them in twelve beds of a plot. Tap a picture, then a bed. No timer or score. Free to play and print.
garden-planner.short: Choose plant pictures and lay out a plot of twelve beds.
garden-planner.players: Solo, or 2 people side by side
garden-planner.intro: Choose pictures from a tray of plants and garden things, then tap a bed to put each one in place. A plot has twelve beds, and a bed holds one picture. A summary in words says what the plan has, such as "Your plan has 3 sunflowers, 2 roses and 1 tree." Nothing is timed, scored or saved, and there are no turns. This is a picture plan to talk about, not planting advice. "Print the plan" prints the beds with the pictures you chose, with blank beds to draw in and lines for notes.
howTo: Tap a picture in the tray. It shows "Chosen" while it is selected.
Tap a bed. The picture goes there, and the choice is put down.
To change a bed, choose another picture and tap the bed. To clear a bed, tap it with no picture chosen.
Tap "Start again" to empty every bed, and "Put it back" if you change your mind.
Tap "Print the plan" for a paper copy of the plot and the summary.
tips: Talk about each picture as it goes in, such as "the sunflower goes by the birdhouse". Talking makes it a shared activity.
Let each person choose a picture in turn, or choose the pictures together, so both have a say in the plot.
On paper, the blank beds are for drawing in your own ideas, and the notes lines are for anything you want to remember.

faq.q: Is this planting advice?
faq.a: No. This is a picture plan to talk about, not planting advice. It does not say when, where or how to plant anything, because that depends on where you live.

faq.q: Is there a timer, a score or a winner?
faq.a: No. Nothing is timed, scored, rated or counted, and nobody wins. A full plot gets no special message.

faq.q: Are the pictures we choose saved or sent?
faq.a: No. The plan stays on this page only. It is not saved, uploaded or counted, and it is gone when you close the page.

faq.q: Is there a paper version?
faq.a: Yes. "Print the plan" prints one page, on A4 or US Letter. It shows the twelve beds with the pictures you chose, the summary in words, and blank lines for notes.

faq.q: Is it free, and do I need to sign up?
faq.a: Yes, it is free, and there is no account, sign-up or download. It works in the web browser on a phone, tablet or computer.

coloring-wall.name: Group coloring wall
coloring-wall.seoTitle: Group Coloring Wall: One Picture for Many Hands
coloring-wall.h1: Group Coloring Wall: One Big Picture, Colored Together
coloring-wall.description: Print one large picture across several pages, so a family, a class or a care home can color one wall together. Free to print. No timer or score.
coloring-wall.short: Print one big picture across pages for many people to color.
coloring-wall.players: A group, at a table or on a wall
coloring-wall.intro: Choose a picture from the coloring pages and a wall of 4, 6 or 9 pages. Print the wall: the first page shows how to put it together, and each of the other pages is one part of the same big picture, with a label such as A1 in its corner. Each person colors one or more pages, in any colors and any style. The pages are then laid out by their labels and joined with tape on the back. Nothing is timed, scored or saved.
howTo: Choose a picture, then choose how many pages the wall has.
Read the map on the screen, which shows where each label goes.
Tap "Print the wall" and print all the pages.
Give each person one or more pages to color. Colors and styles do not need to match.
Lay the pages out by their labels, and join them with tape on the back.
tips: Give the pages with the simplest outlines to the people who want a quieter task, and the busier ones to anyone who enjoys them.
Hang the wall where everyone can see it, and talk about the parts together.
Choose a smaller wall for a small table, and a bigger one for a room.

faq.q: Is there a timer, a score or a winner?
faq.a: No. Nothing is timed, scored or counted, and nobody wins. The wall is simply a picture that many people colored.

faq.q: Are the pages saved or sent anywhere?
faq.a: No. The wall is made on this page only. It is not saved, uploaded or counted, and it is gone when you close the page.

faq.q: Do the colors have to match?
faq.a: No. Every person can use any colors and any style. The pages still join up into one picture.

faq.q: Is there a paper version?
faq.a: Yes. The printed wall is the whole game: a first page with the steps and a map, and one page for each part of the picture.

faq.q: Is it free, and do I need to sign up?
faq.a: Yes, it is free, and there is no account, sign-up or download. It works in the web browser on a phone, tablet or computer.

quiet-shapes.name: Quiet shapes puzzle
quiet-shapes.seoTitle: Quiet Shapes Puzzle: Fit Shapes Into a Picture
quiet-shapes.h1: Quiet Shapes Puzzle: Fit the Pieces into the Picture
quiet-shapes.description: Fit simple shapes into the outline of a house, a boat, a fish and more. Tap a piece, then a space of the same shape. There is no timer or score. Free to play and print.
quiet-shapes.short: Fit simple shapes into a picture, at your own pace.
quiet-shapes.intro: A picture outline, such as a house, a boat or a rocket, is divided into spaces. Each space has a piece of the same shape, a large or small triangle, a square, a parallelogram or a rectangle. Tap a piece, then tap a space of the same shape, and it fits. The space turns the piece for you, so there is nothing to drag or rotate. If a piece is a different shape from a space, it stays in the tray with a short note. Nothing is timed or scored, and nothing is saved or sent. "Print this shape" prints the outline and its pieces on one page to color or cut out.
howTo: Tap a piece in the tray. It shows "Chosen" while it is selected.
Tap a space in the picture. If the shape matches, the piece fits there.
If it does not match, try another space. Nothing is lost by trying.
Tap a piece in the picture to take it back to the tray, or use "Start again" to take all of them back.
When every space has its piece, the picture is complete. Tap "Another shape" for a new one, or tap Rest to stop.
tips: Turn on the hint lines to see each space. Turn them off for more of a puzzle, with only the outline to go by.
Start with the big shapes, such as the large triangles and the rectangles. The small pieces often go last.
Name the shapes out loud as you go: "a triangle, a square, a long rectangle". Talking together can make it a shared activity.
On paper, color the pieces with two or three colors, or cut them out with an adult helping.

faq.q: Ļe ilo timer, score ak move count?
faq.a: Aet. Ej ļo timer, ej kōṃṃan ļo score, ak ej kōṃṃan ļo move. Pīn ilo ṃour eo ej jab ṃōṃōt, ej ṃōttan ilo raar eo jiban dōṃ, im kōṃṃan jān kin bōk ļo ejeļā.

faq.q: Ļe ilo kain ļo ṃour ej kanooj ak ļo jibboon?
faq.a: Aet. Ļo bōk ej jouj ilo peej ṃan kein kwōj. Ej jab kanooj, uploaded ak kōṃṃan, im ej mōj ke kwōj kāṃ ij ļōk peej.

faq.q: Ļe ilo raar ļo bōk ilo ajri eo ej ṃōttan, ak bōk ilo sukūn eo?
faq.a: Lōṃ eo ilo peej ej jiban ke ilo ṃōṃōt eo ajri eo ļōk ilo bōk, im raar lōk eo kōṃṃan ej wōṃ eo ilo ṃōṃōt ṃan kōṃṃan ļo, ļōk ilo bōk ro ke ṃan Tab. Ļo iturin ilo tray ro ej bōk ko eo ilo peej.

faq.q: Ļe ilo kōṃṃan ļo bōk ilo pepa?
faq.a: Aet. "Print this shape" ej print ļo kōṃṃan ilo peej ṃokajri: lōṃ ko ṃan hint lines ro, im ļo iturin ro ilo ṃōṃōt ṃan ṃōṃōt ṃan eo. Kōṃṃan ļo ro ilo bōk, ak kōṃṃan ļo ro ilo aet ṃan kōṃṃan ļo ro. Ajri eo ej kōṃṃan.

faq.q: Ļe ej eo ro ļo, ak ļe ilo aer ilo sign up?
faq.a: Aet, ej eo, im ej jab account, sign-up ak download. Ej kōṃṃan ilo web browser ilo phone, tablet ak computer.

calm-breathing.name: Menono kōn aenōm̧m̧an
calm-breathing.seoTitle: Kōṃṃan Ļo Kōṃṃan Ļōk Ro Ilo Ṃōṃōt
calm-breathing.h1: Juon Kakkije in Menono kōn Aenōm̧m̧an
calm-breathing.description: Juon kakkije in menono eo erum̧wij im aenōm̧m̧an n̄an kwaļo̧k ippān doon: juon kōm̧akōm̧a ej kilepļo̧k im dikļo̧k kōn jiljino alen menono. Kwōj jinoe, im kwomaron̄ kabōjrake ilo jabdewōt iien.
calm-breathing.short: Juon kōm̧akōm̧a erum̧wij n̄an menono ippān. Jinoe im kabōjrake n̄e kwōj kōņaan.
calm-breathing.intro: Jet iien makūtkūt eo em̧m̧antata ej juon kakkije eaenōm̧m̧an. Jitōn̄e "Start", innem menono n̄an iloan n̄e kōm̧akōm̧a eo ej kilepļo̧k im menono n̄an nabōj n̄e ej dikļo̧k. Kāālōt m̧ōkaj ak erum̧wijļo̧k. Ejjab juon taktō ak uno n̄an kōmour, ak ej juon iien eaenōm̧m̧an wōt n̄an pād ippān doon.
howTo: Jijet ilo aenōm̧m̧an iturin doon.
Kāālōt m̧ōkaj eo: erum̧wij ak em̧m̧an wōt.
Jitōn̄e "Start". Menono n̄an iloan ilo an kōm̧akōm̧a eo kilepļo̧k, im menono n̄an nabōj ilo an dikļo̧k.
Enaaj make bōjrak ālikin jiljino alen menono, ak jitōn̄e "Stop" ilo jabdewōt iien kwōj kōņaan.
tips: Dōbōk pein doon ak likūt peim̧ ioon pātin pein armej eo n̄e ej errā kake.
Jab kipel armej eo. N̄e rekōņaan kalimjek wōt, ekanooj em̧m̧an.
N̄e ewōr jorrāān ilo menono, menono wōt ilo jim̧we im kalimjek wōt kōm̧akōm̧a eo. Kajjitōk ippān taktō kōn jabdewōt inepata kōn menono.

faq.q: Men in ej ke juon makūtkūt in menono kōn taktō?
faq.a: Jaab. Ej juon kakkije bidodo n̄an aenōm̧m̧an im pād ippān doon. Ejjab juon taktō ak uno n̄an inepata ak jabdewōt nan̄inmej. Kōnono ippān taktō kōn jabdewōt kajjitōk kōn ājmour.

faq.q: Kōm̧akōm̧a eo ej ke make emmakūt n̄e ijjan̄in jinoe?
faq.a: Jaab. Ejjeļo̧k men ej makūtkūt m̧ae iien kwoj jiped Start, im ej bōjrak ālikin jiljino menono ak n̄e kwoj jiped Stop. Ñe kein kōjerbal eo am̧ em̧ōj kōm̧m̧ane bwe en dikļo̧k makūtkūt, naan ko rej oktak ilo an jab kilepļo̧k serkōl eo.

faq.q: Ejjeļo̧k ke wōņāān, im ij aikuj ke sain up?
faq.a: Aet, ejjeļo̧k wōņāān, im ejjeļo̧k akaun, sain up, ak daunlood. Ej jerbal ilo web browser ilo teḷboon, teblet, ak kombiuta.

story-chain.name: Story chain
story-chain.seoTitle: Story Chain: Kōṃṃan Ļo Ilo Peej Ṃan Ṃōṃōt
story-chain.h1: Story Chain: Kōṃṃan Ļo Ilo Peej Ṃokajri Ilo Peej Ṃokajri
story-chain.description: Ļo peej ko ej ṃōttan ilo ṃokajri, im kein ṃōṃōt ej ṃōttan ilo kōṃṃan kwōj. Jab ļo kein kōṃṃan ļo, jab ko eo ṃokajri. Ej eo, ṃōṃōt, jab timer ak jab score.
story-chain.short: Kōṃṃan ļo ilo peej, im ṃōṃōt ṃōṃōt ṃan eo.
story-chain.intro: Kōṃṃan ej ṃōttan ilo ļo peej ṃokajri, im ļo chain ej ṃōttan ṃokajri ilo peej ṃokajri. Kein ṃōṃōt ej ṃōttan ļo sentence ṃan chain eo ej ṃōttan, ṃan kōṃṃan ļo, ṃan ṃōṃōt. Sentence ej ṃōttan ļo ilo ṃōṃōt eo, ilo place eo ej ṃōttan kwōj ṃan, ak ļo eo ej ṃōṃōt. Jab ļo ej kōṃṃan, jab ej record, im jab ej ṃōttan ļo ṃokajri. Chain ej ṃōttan ilo eight ṃōṃōt, im ṃōttan ļo bōk ṃan ṃōttan ej ṃōttan.
howTo: Look at the first picture together.
Take turns: each person says one sentence about the chain so far. Anyone may pass.
Tap "Add a picture" to put the next picture at the end of the chain.
Tap "Take the last one off" if you would rather go back a picture.
When the chain has eight pictures, tap "Start a new chain" for a fresh one, or simply stop.
tips: Short is fine: "Someone put the kettle on." The next person carries on, or passes.
Let the pictures lead. There is no story you are meant to arrive at.
Stop whenever you like. Stopping halfway is a perfectly good way to finish.

faq.q: Ļe ilo timer ak score?
faq.a: Aet. Ej ļo clock, score, move counter ak losing. Pīn ilo ṃour eo ej jab ṃōṃōt, im ṃōttan ilo raar eo jiban dōṃ, ej ṃōttan ilo ṃōṃōt kōṃṃan ļo.

faq.q: Ļe ilo kain ļo ṃour ej type ak record?
faq.a: Aet. Sentence ro ej kōṃṃan ilo aer ṃōṃōt, ej jab type, record ak ej ṃōttan ilo ejeļā. Game eo ej kōṃṃan ļo peej ro ṃōṃōt.

faq.q: Ļe ilo aer ļo ṃōṃōt ejjab ṃōṃōt?
faq.a: Ṃōṃōt ko ejeļā ej ṃōttan pass, im kein ṃōṃōt ej ṃōttan ilo ṃōṃōt eo. Jab ļo ej ṃōttan name ak remember ļo peej.

faq.q: Ļe ej eo ro ļo, ak ļe ilo aer ilo sign up?
faq.a: Aet, ej eo, im ej jab account, sign-up ak download. Ej kōṃṃan ilo web browser ilo phone, tablet ak computer.

quiet-scene.name: Quiet scene
quiet-scene.seoTitle: Quiet Scene: Ļo Ṃōṃōt Ilo Peej Ṃōṃōt
quiet-scene.h1: Quiet Scene: Ļo Peej Ṃōṃōt Ilo Peej Ṃōṃōt
quiet-scene.description: Ļo peej ṃōṃōt, ṃokajri, ṃan kōṃṃan ļo ṃōṃōt eo ilo lōṃ. Press Next ak Previous ṃan ṃōṃōt ko eo. Jab ļo ej ṃōttan ļo ak play ilo ejeļā, im jab timer ak score. Eo ilo account.
quiet-scene.short: Kōṃṃan ļo peej ṃōṃōt ilo peej ṃōṃōt, ilo jiban ṃōṃōt.
quiet-scene.players: Ṃōṃōt, ak ṃan ṃōṃōt ilo ṃōṃōt
quiet-scene.intro: Ļo peej ṃōṃōt ej ṃōttan ilo screen, ṃan kōṃṃan ļo ṃōṃōt eo ilo lōṃ. Press "Next picture" ak "Previous picture" ṃan ṃōṃōt ko eo. Jab ļo ej ṃōttan, jab ej ṃōttan ilo ejeļā, im jab timer. Tap "Bigger picture" ṃan ṃōttan ļo peej, ṃan ṃōṃōt ko ej ṃōttan ilo television.
howTo: Look at the picture together.
Read the line under it aloud if you like.
Press "Next picture" or "Previous picture" when you are ready.
Tap "Bigger picture" to show only the picture, and "Show everything" to bring the rest back.
Stop whenever you like with "Done for now".
tips: Let the person choose when to move on: wait for them to look, then press Next.
For a group, use "Bigger picture" on a television or large screen and sit where everyone can see it.
There is no right way to look at a picture. Simply talking about one is a complete activity.

faq.q: Ļe ilo timer ak score?
faq.a: Aet. Ej ļo clock, score, move counter ak losing. Pīn ilo ṃour eo ej jab ṃōṃōt, im ṃōttan ilo raar eo jiban dōṃ, ej ṃōttan ilo ṃōṃōt kōṃṃan ļo.

faq.q: Ļe ilo sound ak move?
faq.a: Aet. Ej jab sound, im jab ṃōttan, fade ak jab ṃōṃōt ilo ejeļā. Peej eo ej ṃōttan ṃōṃōt ko eo press ilo button.

faq.q: Ikin ļo ilo kōnono?
faq.a: Jaab. Ņe ilo ilo screen ilo kōṃan kōn eo. Ļo kōṃān ko eo ro iaan eo ilo mejān ļo, ej jiļu ļo ilo tebļe.

faq.q: Ej kōṃān ilo, ak ebōk ļo juon account?
faq.a: Ej, kōṃān, ak jaab account, kōṃān ilo ibbeļ ak download. Ej kōṃmōn ilo web browser ilo phone, tablet ak computer.

color-wash.name: Color wash
color-wash.seoTitle: Color Wash: Soft Color Across a Page
color-wash.h1: Color Wash: Paint Soft Color Across a Page
color-wash.description: Juon brush ļo jouļ ņe kōṃan wash ilo kōlor, ilo juon page, ilo eeñ kōlor ak juon bwe ko ilo ebōj ak eaaeo. Jaab end, jaab score ak jaab timer. Kōṃān ilo ibbeļ, ak jaab account.
color-wash.short: Ļo wash ilo kōlor ilo juon page, ilo kōṃān ko jān ņan kōṃān.
color-wash.players: Juon, ak 2 ņe ilo juon ļo
color-wash.intro: Juon page ak juon brush ņan. Kōṃān juon kōlor ak juon size ņan brush, eo jipen ilo drag ilo page ņan kōṃan juon wash. Page eo jaab end: jaab wōņe ņe kōṃān, jaab picture ņe kōṃān ņan ebōk, ak jaab score. Kōṃān wash ļo ņe kōṃan, ak ļo ņe kōṃan kōnono. Page ņe kōṃan ļo eo ņan ļo, ak Put it back ņe kōṃan wash ļo.
howTo: Kōṃān juon kōlor. Kōlor jipen ilo name ņan.
Kōṃān Wide ak Very wide. Very wide ej kōṃan ļo page ilo juon stroke.
Drag ilo page ilo finger, mouse ak pen ņan kōṃan juon wash.
Ak kōṃān arrow keys ņan kōṃān brush ring, ak Space ņan brush down ak up.
Tap "A fresh page" ņan kōṃan page ņe kōṃan, ak "Put it back" ņe kōṃan wash ļo.
tips: Ļo ļo ņe kōṃan kōlor ņan wash eo ņan ļo, ak kōṃān kōlor ilo kōṃan ļo.
Very wide ej ļo ņan steer ilo shaky hand, bwe brush ej jaab need ņan exact.
Jaab way ņe rījet ņan paint. Stop jipen ņe kōṃan, ak tap "Done for now".

faq.q: Ikin finish, score ak timer?
faq.a: Jaab. Page eo jaab end. Jaab ņe ej finish, count, time ak score, ak jaab message ņe kōṃan ļo ņe kōṃan ļo.

faq.q: Ikin page ej save ak send?
faq.a: Jaab. Jaab ņe ej save, print ak send ilo ļo. Wash ļo ej tōr ilo page eo ilo kōṃan ļo leave.

faq.q: Ej kōṃān ļo ilo mouse ak touch screen?
faq.a: Ej. Ilo page focus, arrow keys ej kōṃan brush ring, ak Space key ej brush down ak up. Screen ej say "Brush down" ak "Brush up" jipen.

faq.q: Ikin version ilo paper?
faq.a: Jaab. Watercolor ilo paper ej ļo idea ņan, juon brush ilo wet ak juon kōlor ilo juon kōṃān, ņe ej juon activity ņe ilo kōṃan ilo tebļe.

faq.q: Ikin kōlor ko?
faq.a: Yellow, orange, green ak purple, kōlor ņan ko eo ļo ilo game ļo ņe ilo picture ņan. Jipen juon name ilo writing, ak name eo ej show ilo ņe ilo choice.

faq.q: Ej kōṃān ilo, ak ebōk ļo juon sign-up?
faq.a: Ej, kōṃān, ak jaab account, sign-up ak download. Ej kōṃmōn ilo web browser ilo phone, tablet ak computer.
